decisions.reason: Changing the Power Board to four PCB layers does not alter the battery connector's placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The PCB layer count does not change the specified interboard connector types, designations, pin counts, or pinouts.
The four-layer decision does not alter the battery connector's electrical series, pitch, pinout, pin count, or mounting type.
The client asks about assembly pricing and component availability but does not change the existing component sourceability or cost-selection policy.
The Power Board layer-count decision does not change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The four-layer PCB decision does not alter the switched 5V rail's converter, GPIO control, pull-down, powered loads, or operating pattern.
